anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a live trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Evaluate AI system's configuration and functionality to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Review trading strategies and market conditions to ensure the platform is effectively engaging in trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate analysis of CPU-intensive processes and optimize or redistribute workloads to reduce load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or crashes, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to identify and resolve issues preventing learning and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Assess trading strategies and market conditions to determine why no trades are active and adjust strategies as needed.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring active trading is crucial for platform profitability and user engagement.
